response.sql: SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance) AS share FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance) > 0 ORDER BY share DESC, event_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Total attendance is the count of all rows in the attendance table; only events with at least one attendance record are considered. Ties at the 10th place are broken by event_id.
